assumptions: The supplied classifications and factual stipulations are true.
No later amendment or other applicable authority displaces the selected clause.

facts.name: authorised_public_fund
facts.rationale: The case stipulates an SFC-authorised fund for the relevant public offering context.

facts.name: is_laf
facts.rationale: The case stipulates that the fund is not a listed closed-ended alternative asset fund.

facts.name: direct_exposure
facts.rationale: The case gives only the combined direct and indirect exposure, not the separate direct amount.

facts.name: indirect_exposure
facts.rationale: The case gives only the combined direct and indirect exposure, not the separate indirect amount.

facts.name: nav
facts.rationale: The case states the combined exposure as exactly 50% of NAV but provides no exact integer valuation amounts.

facts.name: operative_designation
facts.rationale: No SFC designation fact is supplied, and the threshold route independently determines this predicate's result.

mappings.rationale: Both the case question and the candidate ask whether an in-scope fund has a contemporaneous classification basis. Exactly 50% satisfies the threshold route, so the predicate is true despite unknown component amounts and designation.

source_evidence.quote: A Fund will be considered as a complex product if its total direct and indirect exposures to private market assets amount to 50% or more of the Fund’s NAV. On a case-by-case basis, the SFC may also designate a Fund as a complex product, taking into account factors including, without limitation:
Except for listed closed-ended alternative asset funds (LAFs).

mappings.rationale: The case asks whether the fund is definitely non-complex. The candidate asks only whether a contemporaneous classification basis exists and expressly says a false result does not establish non-complex status or resolve historical persistence. No designation evidence also does not establish absence of an operative designation.
The case asks whether this circular establishes the fund's classification despite the LAF exclusion. The candidate is scoped to in-scope funds and gives no answer for out-of-scope funds.

assumptions: The supplied classifications and factual stipulations are true.
No later amendment or other applicable authority displaces the selected clause.

facts.name: authorised_public_fund
facts.rationale: The case states the fund is in scope under the circular, having already been classified complex under it.

facts.name: is_laf
facts.rationale: The case states the fund is in scope under the circular; the candidate's scope excludes LAFs.

facts.name: direct_exposure
facts.rationale: No contemporaneous direct exposure amount is provided; prior complex classification does not determine this component.

facts.name: indirect_exposure
facts.rationale: No contemporaneous indirect exposure amount is provided; prior complex classification does not determine this component.

facts.name: operative_designation
facts.rationale: The case stipulates that the fund has already been classified complex, but does not specify whether this resulted from an operative SFC designation at the assessment time. No solicitation fact is not a classification input.

mappings.rationale: The case asks whether a suitability requirement is stated for an already-classified complex fund sold without solicitation or recommendation. The candidate instead asks whether a contemporaneous classification basis exists, the negation of which is a different proposition from absence of a suitability requirement. Therefore the question is not aligned.

source_evidence.quote: A Fund classified as a complex product will be subject to the SFC’s prevailing requirements for the sale of complex products8 including but not limited to ensuring the suitability of the Fund for its investors irrespective of whether solicitation or recommendation is involved.
